question: 家用电器里Instant Pot的销售额是多少？
reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dp.category = '家用电器'
  AND dp.brand = 'Instant Pot';

GROUP BY p.category, d.year, d.month
ORDER BY p.category, d.year, d.month;

WHERE dp.product_name = '雀巢金牌速溶咖啡'

question: 铂金会员买家用电器花了多少钱？
reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_amount
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.member_level = '铂金'
  AND p.category = '家用电器';

JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dp.category = '休闲零食'

GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY 销售额排名;

reference_sql: SELECT d.year AS 年份, d.month AS 月份, SUM(o.order_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS 订单数, ROUND(SUM(o.order_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS AOV FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id = d.date_id GROUP BY d.year, d.month ORDER BY d.year, d.month;

- name: AOV

  relevant_columns:

  - fact_order.order_quantity
  alias:
  - 平均单价
  - 平均订单金额
- name: GMV
  description: 全称Gross Merchandise Value，表示所有订单的成交金额总和。

  - 订单总额

date: '2026-09-20'
weekday: Sunday
quarter: Q3

【数据库环境】
version: 8.0.46
dialect: mysql

【用户查询】
Nike的客单价是多少？

SELECT AVG(fo.order_amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dp.brand IN ('Nike', '耐克');

question: 西南大区家用电器的销售额是多少？
reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dr.region_name = '西南'
  AND dp.category = '家用电器';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE r.region_name = '西南'
  AND p.category = '家用电器';

  alias:

  - 平均订单金额

date: '2026-09-20'
weekday: Sunday
quarter: Q3

【数据库环境】
version: 8.0.46
dialect: mysql

【用户查询】
白银会员买家用电器花了多少钱？

SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS total_amount
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dc.member_level = '白银'
  AND dp.category = '家用电器';

question: Dyson平均每单多少钱？
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(fo.order_amount) AS avg_order_amount FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE dp.brand = '戴森';

SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS total_amount
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id

  AND dp.category = '服饰';

weekday: Sunday
quarter: Q3

version: 8.0.46
dialect: mysql

【用户查询】
李维斯的订单数是多少？
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS order_count FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE dp.brand = '李维斯';

question: 华中的休闲零食有多少订单？
reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS order_count
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dr.region_name = '华中'
  AND dp.category = '休闲零食';

FROM fact_order f

SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dp.category = '鞋靴'
  AND dd.month = 1;

date: '2026-09-20'
weekday: Sunday
quarter: Q3

【数据库环境】
version: 8.0.46
dialect: mysql

【用户查询】
黄金会员买服饰花了多少钱？

SELECT SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.member_level = '黄金' AND p.category = '服饰'

question: 北京有多少笔订单？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_order AS f INNER JOIN dim_region AS r ON f.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.province = '北京市';

reference_sql:
WITH period_data AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20260901 AND 20260920 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS current_gmv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20260801 AND 20260820 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS prev_month_gmv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20250901 AND 20250920 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS prev_year_gmv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20260901 AND 20260920 THEN order_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS current_qty,
    SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20260801 AND 20260820 THEN order_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS prev_month_qty,
    SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20250901 AND 20250920 THEN order_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS prev_year_qty
  FROM fact_order
)
SELECT
  'GMV' AS metric,
  current_gmv AS current_value,
  prev_month_gmv AS prev_month_value,
  ROUND((current_gmv - prev_month_gmv) / NULLIF(prev_month_gmv, 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_growth_rate,
  prev_year_gmv AS prev_year_value,
  ROUND((current_gmv - prev_year_gmv) / NULLIF(prev_year_gmv, 0) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_rate
FROM period_data
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'AOV' AS metric,
  ROUND(current_gmv / NULLIF(current_qty, 0), 2) AS current_value,
  ROUND(prev_month_gmv / NULLIF(prev_month_qty, 0), 2) AS prev_month_value,
  ROUND((current_gmv / NULLIF(current_qty, 0) - prev_month_gmv / NULLIF(prev_month_qty, 0)) / NULLIF(prev_month_gmv / NULLIF(prev_month_qty, 0), 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_growth_rate,
  ROUND(prev_year_gmv / NULLIF(prev_year_qty, 0), 2) AS prev_year_value,
  ROUND((current_gmv / NULLIF(current_qty, 0) - prev_year_gmv / NULLIF(prev_year_qty, 0)) / NULLIF(prev_year_gmv / NULLIF(prev_year_qty, 0), 0) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_rate
FROM period_data;

question: 有什么异常吗
reference_sql:
WITH daily_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    d.date_id,
    SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(f.order_quantity) AS qty
  FROM fact_order f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
  GROUP BY d.date_id
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(gmv) AS avg_gmv,
    STDDEV_SAMP(gmv) AS std_gmv,
    AVG(order_cnt) AS avg_cnt,
    STDDEV_SAMP(order_cnt) AS std_cnt,
    AVG(qty) AS avg_qty,
    STDDEV_SAMP(qty) AS std_qty
  FROM daily_metrics
)
SELECT
  m.date_id,
  m.gmv,
  m.order_cnt,
  m.qty,
  s.avg_gmv,
  s.avg_cnt,
  CASE
    WHEN m.gmv > s.avg_gmv + 3 * s.std_gmv THEN 'GMV异常偏高'
    WHEN m.gmv < s.avg_gmv - 3 * s.std_gmv THEN 'GMV异常偏低'
    WHEN m.order_cnt > s.avg_cnt + 3 * s.std_cnt THEN '订单量异常偏高'
    WHEN m.order_cnt < s.avg_cnt - 3 * s.std_cnt THEN '订单量异常偏低'
    WHEN m.qty > s.avg_qty + 3 * s.std_qty THEN '销量异常偏高'
    WHEN m.qty < s.avg_qty - 3 * s.std_qty THEN '销量异常偏低'
  END AS anomaly_type
FROM daily_metrics m
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE m.gmv > s.avg_gmv + 3 * s.std_gmv
   OR m.gmv < s.avg_gmv - 3 * s.std_gmv
   OR m.order_cnt > s.avg_cnt + 3 * s.std_cnt
   OR m.order_cnt < s.avg_cnt - 3 * s.std_cnt
   OR m.qty > s.avg_qty + 3 * s.std_qty
   OR m.qty < s.avg_qty - 3 * s.std_qty
ORDER BY m.date_id;

  - 订单总额

date: '2026-09-20'
weekday: Sunday
quarter: Q3

【数据库环境】
version: 8.0.46
dialect: mysql

【用户查询】
卖得最好的5个商品是什么？

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, p.category, SUM(o.order_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, p.category ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 销售额最高的前5个商品是哪些？
reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_sales
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

question: 华东大区休闲零食的销量是多少？
reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS 销量
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
WHERE dr.region_name = '华东'
  AND dp.category = '休闲零食';

FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
WHERE dr.region_name = '华南'
  AND dp.category = '家用电器';

reference_sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.order_amount), 0) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE r.region_name = '华南'
  AND p.category = '家用电器';

question: 品类和月份交叉的销售额
reference_sql:
SELECT
  p.category AS `品类`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 1 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `1月`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 2 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `2月`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 3 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `3月`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 4 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `4月`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 5 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `5月`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 6 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `6月`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 7 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `7月`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 8 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `8月`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 9 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `9月`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 10 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `10月`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 11 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `11月`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 12 THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `12月`
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id = d.date_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

2. 若指标信息中存在相关指标定义，必须严格遵循其业务口径、计算逻辑、过滤规则与时间口径，不得偏离或重解释，若指标信息未覆盖用户问题中的指标或口径，则基于用户问题语义与通用业务常识进行。
3. 生成的SQL只能用于查询，不能涉及数据写入、更新、删除等操作。
4. 生成的SQL的语法必须严格符合数据库环境中指定的数据库类型与版本。
5. 默认只生成一条SQL，不可生成多条SQL。

    role: dimension

    role: dimension

    - 服饰
    - 食品饮料
    - 休闲零食
    description: 商品所属品类。
    alias:

    - 品类
    - 分类
  - name: product_id
    type: varchar(20)
    role: primary_key
    examples:

    - P007

    type: float
    role: measure
    examples:

    role: primary_key

    - ORD20250104001

    description: 订单唯一标识。

【可参考的指标信息】
- name: AOV
  description: 全称Average Order Value，表示所有订单的成交金额平均值。
  relevant_columns:
  - fact_order.order_amount
  - fact_order.order_quantity
  alias:
  - 平均单价
  - 平均订单金额
- name: GMV
  description: 全称Gross Merchandise Value，表示所有订单的成交金额总和。
  relevant_columns:
  - fact_order.order_amount
  alias:
  - 成交总额
  - 订单总额

【当前时间信息】
date: '2026-09-20'
weekday: Sunday
quarter: Q3

【数据库环境】
version: 8.0.46
dialect: mysql

【用户查询】
销售额不足5000的品牌是哪些？
SELECT p.brand, SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_sales FROM dim_product p JOIN fact_order o ON p.product_id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.brand HAVING SUM(o.order_amount) < 5000;

question: Oreo卖了多少件？
reference_sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fo.order_quantity), 0) AS total_quantity
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dp.product_name LIKE '%Oreo%'
   OR dp.brand LIKE '%Oreo%'
   OR dp.product_name LIKE '%奥利奥%'
   OR dp.brand LIKE '%奥利奥%';

  AND p.category = '休闲零食';

GROUP BY d.`year`, d.`month`
ORDER BY d.`year`, d.`month`;
